h1: Custom Sublimation Eyewear for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom sublimation eyewear in bulk. Fully printed designs on frames and lenses. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Sublimation eyewear lets you print full-color, edge-to-edge designs directly onto frames and polarized lenses. Unlike standard screen printing or laser engraving, sublimation bonds the ink into the material so it won't peel, crack, or fade — even after hours of outdoor use. This makes sublimated sunglasses, safety glasses, and readers a smart choice for trade shows, uniform programs, and branded retail merchandise where vibrant, all-over artwork matters.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation eyewear with full-color printed frames and polarized lenses for branding
